limitations: Original allocator operatorNewOrAbort (20), malloc/free/memcpy and component-pool services are runtime.call dependencies.
Factory, destructor and initializer calls retain typed table dispatch; their bodies are replaced independently by the registry.
Differential validation is bounded, not proof for every overlapping/corrupt-memory state.
The destructor-after-factory path and invalid signature/null result paths use declared test table callbacks; ordinary game factory bodies do not reenter.
Original behavior equivalence does not establish recovery of original C++ source names or class declarations.
